newsitem.title: USA: Payless ShoeSource Feb same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Payless ShoeSource Feb same-store sales up.

text.p: Payless ShoeSource Inc said Thursday that its same-store sales for the four weeks ended March 1 rose 3.7 percent.
Total sales were $148.3 million, up one percent from the $146.8 million reported in the similar period in 1996.
February is the first month of Payless ShoeSource's fiscal year.
Payless ShoeSource said it opened six new stores and closed 10. At the end of February, Payless operated 4,232 stores, versus 4,498 last year.
